BiblicalUsage: Vomit is the picture of the fool and the drunkard: as a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly; the LORD hath mingled a perverse spirit in Egypt, and they have caused Egypt to err, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit; and Moab shall wallow in his vomit, and he also shall be in derision.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the vomit as the end of folly, because the fool goes back to what made him sick.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
